title: Choose the output
text: Press the browse button beside Output folder and select a destination.

await.hint: Press the browse button beside Output folder.

title: Load the example
text: Press Load example to generate a deterministic demonstration measurement (two detectors, hundreds of thousands of photons) in the settings cache and load it — the output folder is set beside it, ready to split. Press the browse button beside Input file instead to choose a real TTTR measurement. The guide does not choose a file for you.

title: Set formats and split options
text: Choose the input container and the output container, then the chunk size and binning. Disable Split into files for a single output. Keep original protects the source.

title: Convert or split
text: Press Convert / Split when the input and options are ready. The guide waits for this action; progress and status report whether the operation completes successfully.

await.hint: Press Convert / Split in the Input / Output panel.
